hints.title: Shared Prefix Lengths
hints.text: Notice that removing one word only alters the counts of prefixes that belong to that specific word. Precomputing shared prefix counts across all words allows swift updates when removing one item.

hints.title: Trie Prefix Counting
hints.text: Build a prefix tree with all words, counting how many words pass through each node. Also maintain how many nodes at each depth have a visit count of at least k.

hints.title: Simulate Removal and Revert
hints.text: For each word, walk down its nodes, decrement each node visit count, and track when a count drops below k to adjust valid depths. Record the maximum depth with count at least k, then restore the node counts before proceeding.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: L: maximum length of a word
complexity.notes: Each word traverses its prefix path twice per query for removal and restoration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the prefix tree from scratch for every removal takes O(N^2 * L) which exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing the prefix tree in memory enables constant amortized depth lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a prefix tree with rollback and depth-bucket tracking to process queries in linear time.
